title: ios-acceptance-prelude
responsibility: Owns the ios-acceptance-prelude build or maintenance script.

outputs.name: pagePrelude
outputs.description: The JavaScript source of the test-only page prelude, kept as one string of helper declarations (text, panel, footer, field, fill, named, press and pressLink) that expressions the native acceptance run evaluates in the app page may use. This module never runs the string, and the helpers need the page's DOM (document, HTMLInputElement and Event), so the value matters only when that page evaluates it.
